svg.aria-label: nlp & llm engineer with 2+ years of experience delivering 15+ ml systems, specializing in rag pipelines, ai agents (langchain, langgraph), llm fine-tuning, and sentiment analysis. m.sc. in ai & data science (a+) from queen's university, with research on llm decoding optimization that reduced output tokens. proficient in python, pytorch, hugging face, fastapi, docker, aws, sql and git. languages: arabic, english, russian (basics). off-keyboard: chess, gym, reading about 5gw/6gw warfare.
